name: How much should landlords expect to spend on rental property maintenance?

mainEntity.name: How much should landlords expect to spend on rental property maintenance?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of rental maintenance varies depending on the unit size, age, and extent of wear. Minor turnover work like punch-list repairs, drywall patching, and touch-up painting is generally billed on a project or handyman rate. Full-scope turns involving extensive bathroom tile work, subfloor repairs, or complete room repainting require formal estimates. Managing costs effectively involves grouping repairs together into a single visit rather than scheduling multiple isolated service calls, which reduces mobilization and trade trip charges.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs vary from modest fees for small punch-list repairs and paint touch-ups to larger budgets for full turns involving tile, subfloors, and multi-room repairs.
